technical_summary: Observed steady-state: ~120 req/sec (all endpoints) averaging 210 tokens/request (chat mix). Peak observed bursts: up to 950 req/sec during settlement spikes (08:00-10:00 PT) with 700 tokens/request for complex reranking flows. Baseline token/sec numbers: steady ~25k tok/s, peak bursts ~665k tok/s (bursty, multi-minute spikes). Latency targets requested: chat p95 <= 250ms, rerank p95 <= 400ms, p99 targets discussed but deferred for SLA banding. Preferred model mix: open-13b-quant for conversational paths, 70b-rerank-quant for rerank (or external CPU-optimized reranker). Batchability: rerank jobs batch-friendly, chat flows require low-latency continuous batching.
sizing_recommendation: Scenario A (cost-optimized steady + burst buffer): reserve 6 x H100-80GB-equivalent nodes + 2 x burst nodes; supports steady 120 req/s and short bursts to ~400 req/s with degraded p95 for heavy rerank. Estimated monthly COMMIT: $45k-$60k.

Scenario B (balanced SLOs): reserve 10 x H100 nodes with autoscale buffer to 14 nodes for scheduled settlement windows; targets chat p95 220-260ms and rerank p95 ~350-420ms. Estimated ARR range aligns w/ $600k-$1.2M/yr commit.

Scenario C (SLO-first, high headroom): reserve 16 x H100 nodes dedicated (regional pinning for EU), plus dedicated KV-cache nodes and prefix cache; aimed at consistently meeting p95 SLAs including peak; recommended only if legal requires strict credits for missed SLOs. Estimated ARR $1.2M+.

Operational notes: enable prefix/KV caching for payments flows to reduce token/sec load by ~30%. Enable model routing by policy: cheap-13b for common chat path, fallback to 70b-rerank for high-value transactions. Include reserved burst capacity window that mirrors customer settlement schedule (08:00-10:00 PT).
sla_negotiation_points: Define p95 SLO bands per route (chat, rerank, embeddings) and tie credits to 30-day rolling windows.
Agree on measurement methodology (edge vs app vs model service latency) — recommend model-service p95 at inference entrypoint.
Burst SLA: guaranteed baseline throughput for steady-state; agreed soft cap for unscheduled bursts with fallback model variants.
Credit formula: 5% credit per 1% below SLO up to capped amount; require explicit thresholds for p99 degradation.
